findings.summary: Four repeated of phrases naming habits became a four-verb series naming behaviors.

evidence.baseline: have generally developed habits of doing more with less, of refusing scale that would compromise integrity, of holding long time horizons, of working in conditions where the work matters more than the visibility
evidence.shipped: have generally learned to do more with less, refuse scale that would compromise integrity, hold long time horizons, and work where the work matters more than visibility

findings.diagnosis: The repeated of makes four separate habits rather than one four-part disposition, which matters because the paragraph's claim is that undercapitalization produced them independently. Habits of is also not the same as learned to: a habit is something that formed, learning is something the builders did on purpose, and the paragraph attributes the formation to conditions. The final and again closes a set the sentence had left open. This is the eighth instance in Volume II.

findings.summary: A deliberate passive naming what happens to organizations was inverted into an active naming what capital does.

evidence.baseline: Many have lived through cycles of mission-driven organizations being captured by capital, by ideology, or by the gravitational pull of their own success.
evidence.shipped: Many have lived through cycles in which capital, ideology, or the gravitational pull of success captured mission-driven organizations.

findings.diagnosis: This is 4.28 applied against itself. The baseline's passive keeps the organizations in subject position because they are what the builders watched happen, and the three repeated bys separate three unlike forces. The active version makes capital and ideology and a gravitational pull the agents of a verb of intention, which is precisely the personification 4.28 exists to catch. The pass also dropped their own from their own success, which was the point: the third force is not external.

findings.summary: Three claims about particular people were generalized into claims about categories.

evidence.baseline: The builders most likely to succeed at building coherent coordination infrastructure are the ones who have done enough of their own regulatory work ... The builders most worth working with are the ones who have already developed an immune response
evidence.shipped: Builders most likely to succeed at coherent coordination infrastructure have done enough regulatory work of their own ... The builders most worth working with have developed an immune response

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.9 read onto are the ones who.
findings.diagnosis: Are the ones who identifies a subset among builders who exist. Without it the sentence defines what a successful builder is, which is a definition rather than an observation, and the section opened by promising characteristics worth naming rather than criteria. Already before developed also carries the paragraph's timing: the immune response predates the work, which is why it is a selector.

findings.summary: An em dash pair around four kinds of practice became a comma pair, producing the same garden path recorded elsewhere in this batch.

evidence.baseline: at least one form of personal practice—somatic, contemplative, therapeutic, or relational—that has changed their understanding
evidence.shipped: at least one form of personal practice, somatic, contemplative, therapeutic, or relational, that has changed their understanding

findings.diagnosis: The comma pair reads as apposition to practice on second pass and as a series on first, and the relative clause that follows makes the ambiguity worse because that has changed can attach to relational. Repaired here with whether, which marks the four as alternatives and cannot be read as a series continuation. Catalog 4.22's retention limb applies: the bounds matter, because the paragraph's claim is that any one of the four is sufficient.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-02 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F2 is the second instance in this batch of catalog 4.28 being cited to remove an actor rather than recover one, after the same inversion in The Liminal Phase. Both times the pass matched a passive or an abstract subject on surface shape and rewrote toward an active sentence whose new subject was an abstraction performing a human act. Two instances in one volume is enough to say the category is being read as a preference for the active voice, which is not what it says.
